newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close slightly down, seen recovering.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close slightly down, seen recovering.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed slightly lower as invstors traded cautiously in a select band of scrips in financial, pharmaceutical and cement sectors ahead of Moslem Friday weekend, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index closed 6.42 points or 0.5 percent down at 1,273.85 on a turnover of 79.1 million taka. Of 115 traded issues 63 lost and 58 gained.

"The market started to recover after spell of correction over the past several sessions. It may further recover on Saturday," said a broker. Bangladesh Lamps lost 490 to 4,420, Beximco Pharma up 1.27 to 182.31 and Bata Shoe rose 11 to 156.
